title: Engagement of Faculty, Office Assistant, Attendant for RSETIs Alipurduar
organization: Central Bank of India Samajik Utthan Avam Prashikshan Sansthan (CBI-SUAPS)
salary_range: Faculty: Rs.30000/- per month, Office Assistant: Rs.20000/- per month, Attendant: Rs.14000/- per month

important_dates.label: Last Date of Receipt of Application

summary: Central Bank of India Samajik Utthan Avam Prashikshan Sansthan (CBI-SUAPS) is recruiting Faculty, Office Assistants, and Attendants on a contract basis for its RSETI in Alipurduar for the year 2026-27. A total of 5 vacancies are available across these posts. Interested candidates must submit their applications by December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Faculty: Graduate (preference for MSW/MA in Rural Dev./Sociology/Psychology/B.Sc. Agri/B.A with B.Ed.) with sound computer knowledge. Age 22-40 years.
Office Assistant: Graduate (BSW/BA/B.Com) with computer knowledge. Age 22-40 years.
All candidates must be residents of the same State, preferably the same or nearby district/residing at the RSETI Centre headquarters.
how_to_apply_steps: Obtain the application format (Annexure) from the official notice.
Fill out the application form completely.
Address the application to "Regional Manager/Co-Chairman, Dist. Level RSETI Advisory Committee (DLRAC), Central Bank of India, Regional Office Coochbehar, Bangchatra Road, Coochbehar,WB-736101".
Subscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Faculty/Office Assistant/Attendant at RSETI Alipurduar on contract for the FY year 2026-27".
Ensure the application reaches the specified address by December 15, 2026.
Attach self-attested copies of required certificates (service certificate, educational qualifications).
